svg.text: 3D CAD Model 1: Primary Step-Out Flying-Keel Pod on True Kit Discovery 330
True-scale millimeter assembly flying 6"–8" above cruise waterline (Upper Step-Out Wing clear in dry air!)
Ahead of 26 L swappable battery bay
Ø460 mm tubes + rub-strakes + open bow
Interactive 3D STL: models/01_step_out_flying_keel_truekit.stl (click on GitHub to orbit/zoom or 3D-print at 1:15 scale)
